findings.claim: Mercury Research Q2 2026: Intel x86 share fell below 70% (~69.3%) for the first time since 1995; AMD record ~30.7%; AMD server share 34.5% ex-IoT (Intel 65.5%).
findings.source: Mercury Research via CPU Market Share Q2 2026 (basic-tutorials.com)

findings.claim: Q1 2026: AMD EPYC took 46.2% of server x86 revenue; Intel server unit share 66.8% vs 72.8% a year earlier; ARM server unit share 17.7% vs 11.5% (UBS).
findings.source: Tom's Hardware: AMD reaches 46% of server x86 CPU revenue

findings.claim: Tesla is the only officially confirmed 14A customer (TeraFab, April 2026); other reported foundry wins (AMD, NVIDIA, Marvell, Microsoft, Micron, OpenAI) are unconfirmed per KeyBanc/FactSet-cited report; 14A risk production 2028, volume 2029.
findings.source: WCCFtech: Intel 14A wins Tesla, major customers

note: excerpts not verbatim (search summaries); as_of approximate.
